runs.description: All benchmark runs with their status, SUT version, environment and tags. Filter by any dimension and open a run for its details.

compare.description: Compare runs, client devices or parameter values side by side, with absolute and relative differences against a reference.

trends.description: Follow a metric of one case on one client device across runs, over time or over SUT versions.

series.description: Overlay series from different samples and runs, resample and aggregate them.

suites.description: Suites, scenarios and test cases with all their versions.

metrics.description: Metric definitions with their units and direction, and the unit catalogue.

derivedMetrics.description: Define derived metrics in the DSL. They are computed at query time, also for historical runs.

aliases.description: Rename or merge device names, parameter values and other dimension values. Aliases apply everywhere.

tokens.description: API tokens for the benchmark harness and MCP clients. Create and revoke them here.

runDetail.title: Run {{runId}}
runDetail.description: Case executions, samples, series, tags, annotations and attachments of this run.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This page could not be shown. Reload it, or go back to the run list.

placeholder.notBuilt: This view is not built yet.
